title: POST /api/v1/machines/credentials request
description: A signed-in machine asks for another machine's credential: a machine of the account with no sign-in of its own, such as the user's Sprite. Enrolling a machine again replaces its earlier credential.

machine_id.description: The id the enrolled machine will send as `X-Rakumux-Machine-Id`.

name.description: The name it will go by in the feed, shown in the account's list of machines.

wake_url.description: Where a request wakes the machine when a reply is written to it: a Fly Sprite's public URL, nothing else.
